population_rule: Freeze the first 30 newest public open BINARY markets returned by search-markets at initial capture; no replacement, no final-outcome selection. Retain each ID, including after closure or resolution.
scientific_eligibility: Candidates only. Objective criteria, public outcome still unknown, actual negotiability and shared-event key require a versioned manual/external audit before predictive inclusion.
manual_audit_rule: First 10 frozen cohort IDs by SHA256(id); no selection by outcome, probability or liquidity.
clock_and_pairing: Record actual UTC request/receipt intervals per market. First t with two admissible captures targeting 24h apart; never fabricate/backfill a missed day or equate target slot with actual receipt time.
pair_tolerance_status: Operational diagnostic only; scientific timing acceptance must be explicit before any predictive analysis.
market_update_history: Repeated captured states only, not a claim of complete edit history between runs.
read_only_api: HTTPS GET api.manifold.markets/v0/search-markets, market/{id}, bets. No API key, POST, trading, orders or transactions.
output: Immutable per-run raw ZIP, UTC receipt/request metadata, SHA256, plan/code hashes, previous-manifest hash, observations and errors. Daily slot idempotence only after a complete successful run.
stop_rule: No automatic extension beyond 56 days after first successful capture. No predictive scores before temporal, outcome and event audits and independent resolved labels.
duration_and_schedule: Proposed; explicit confirmation recorded separately in deployment.json before enabling daily capture. A manual validation is not scheduling.
visibility_evidence: Anonymous public-search server privacy filter was inspected: visibility=public when uid is absent. API omits visibility in returned market objects. Entry membership is evidence of public discovery, not an emitted visibility field or proof of all later states.
